work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult LVII (address LF10091–10095) permits Bishop Alois Hoffmann of Dulma to be elected Archbishop of Salzburg, his titular see to fall vacant on election; LF10118 mi- → LF10130 nime across provenance of LVI LF10121, own provenance LF10124 and page-69 running title LF10127; complete 4 September 1835 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF10098–10098; the source closing at LF10177–10180 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die quarta septem- bris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
